tagline: Pontiac取景器相机，1948 年发布
description: The Baby Lynx is a 35mm viewfinder camera launched by the French maker Pontiac in 1948Both McKeown and Vial say 1950, but a Pontiac advertisement dated 1948, previously visible at [https://stereocollection.pagesperso-orange.fr/ Stereocollection], shows the Baby Lynx.
